<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(f):
    out=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('B','c','Y','S') and n['pixels']>15:
            b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); r1=max(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b); c1=max(p[1] for p in b)
            if r1>=63 or c1>=63: continue
            out.append((n['color'], r0,c0,r1,c1))
    return sorted(out)
seq = ['SPACE'] + ['UP']*6 + ['SPACE'] + [{'action':'MOUSE','row':26,'col':15}] + ['DOWN']*7 + ['RIGHT']*7
for a in seq:
    action([a])
    r = last_action_result
    if r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done') or r.get('run_complete') or r.get('game_over'):
        print("STOP after", a, r); break
print("final:", snap(current_frame))
print("last result:", {k:v for k,v in last_action_result.items() if k!='valid_actions'})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
